items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: So we kept him playing one night, and he played it too.

ctx.x: Oh, he left here in Chicago too. But I think he's from Mobile, his name was Jackson, some kind of Jackson, Earl Jackson or William Jackson, something. Throw the thing on the side, you know. So we kept him playing one night, and he played it too. And I tried and I got, this is Dizzy's name, ooh, that thing on the Dizzy. I'll never forget a man named Jenkins. He used to have all that old gravel and stuff, you know, Peoples to wake from him. And he gave a big, big dance for the night. And by me getting there early,…
